sentences.text: Xinghaiornis belongs to the unranked order Ornithothoraces, a diverse group of birds and bird-like dinosaurs.
Scientists Xuri Wang, Luis M. Chiappe, Fangfang Teng, and Qiang Ji first named the species in 2013.
This animal lived between 125.77 and 119.57 million years ago in the Early Cretaceous Yixian Formation of western Liaoning Province, northeastern China.
